artists.biography: Split Enz were a New Zealand band of the 1970s and early 1980s featuring Phil Judd and brothers Tim Finn and Neil Finn. They achieved chart success in New Zealand, Australia, and Canada during the early 1980s’ most notably with the single "I Got You", and built a cult following elsewhere. Their musical style was eclectic and original, incorporating influences from art rock, vaudeville, swing, punk, rock, new wave, and pop.

Split Enz.biography: Split Enz were a New Zealand band of the 1970s and early 1980s featuring Phil Judd and brothers Tim Finn and Neil Finn. They achieved chart success in New Zealand, Australia, and Canada during the early 1980s’ most notably with the single "I Got You", and built a cult following elsewhere. Their musical style was eclectic and original, incorporating influences from art rock, vaudeville, swing, punk, rock, new wave, and pop.

perplexity.description:
Dizrythmia," released in 1977, is the third studio album by New Zealand rock band Split Enz. Marking a stylistic evolution, the album blends rock with new wave influences, drawing inspiration from British Invasion-era pop. The production involved renowned engineer Geoff Emerick, known for his work with The Beatles, which contributed to a more straightforward rock and roll sound compared to the band's earlier, more progressive and art rock-oriented work.

This album holds a significant place in Split Enz's discography as it features key singles like "My Mistake" and "Bold As Brass," which helped the band gain wider recognition. It reflects a transitional phase where the band refined their musical identity, balancing experimental elements with accessible rock structures. Released originally on Mushroom and Chrysalis labels, and later reissued by Demon Records, "Dizrythmia" received positive attention for its energetic and polished approach, solidifying Split Enz's reputation in the rock and new wave scenes of the late 1970s.
